task.title: Native RLM, isolated VM agents and codemode integration
task.instructions:
This is an explicitly requested non-legal runtime integration, not a scored comparison. Use native RunAnywhere MiMo and the actual tools; no fabricated results. Keep human approvals, secrets and repository restrictions intact. Do not use storage, external MCP, workflow execution or other hosted services. Do not spawn grandchildren. Produce capability-ledger.md as JSON or a JSON code block, with nonce, persistentValue, functionValue, rlmChildId, codemodeChildId, childResults, and observations.

1. Invoke the managing-child-sessions and analyzing-sessions skills and follow their applicable session/readback guidance.
2. Use ipython to seed rlm_probe_value = sum(range(1001)) and define rlm_probe_add(n) using that retained value. Print RLM_SEEDED with the computed value and a boolean verifying the preloaded prompt includes this nonce: 49efb376-71c2-4ea1-a8c3-3b1db53e76cf. In a separate later ipython call, without reassigning that variable or redefining the function, call rlm_probe_add(7), print RLM_PERSISTENCE and the actual computed result.
3. From ipython, create exactly one VM-backed child with await rlm.spawn(..., name='rlm-reader'). Give it a standalone prompt: invoke managing-child-sessions, read /tmp/broad-legal-workspace/corpus/README.txt, run Python through exec to compute sum([7,11,13]), and write /tmp/broad-legal-workspace/output/rlm-only.txt containing nonce 49efb376-71c2-4ea1-a8c3-3b1db53e76cf and its computed total. It must return JSON with nonce, role='rlm-reader', total, hostname from an actual shell command, and a real excerpt read from README.txt. No child or workflow spawning.
4. Use scripted_tools, the runtime's Python codemode interface. In the script, use opulent_tools.describe to discover read, opulent_session_create and read_subagent schemas. Use asyncio.gather on actual tools.read calls for /tmp/broad-legal-workspace/task/task.json and /tmp/broad-legal-workspace/task/materials/facts.md and print both returned results. Then call tools.opulent_session_create with sessions=[{'prompt': ..., 'title': 'codemode-reader'}] to create exactly one more child with a standalone prompt: invoke managing-child-sessions, read the same corpus README, compute sum([17,19,23]) with exec, and write its nonce/total in output/codemode-only.txt. Return JSON with nonce, role='codemode-reader', total, actual hostname and a real README excerpt. No grandchildren or workflows. Print and retain its returned session_id; queued is not completed. Every tool function must be named literally in the script and awaited.
5. Wait for both children to finish and read their actual completed responses. For the RLM child use await rlm.result(id) in a later ipython cell and print the complete returned output with status. Poll with asyncio.sleep(2) if needed; never treat a running result as complete. For the codemode child, use another scripted_tools call with await tools.read_subagent(agent_id=..., block=True, timeout=90), print the completed response, and repeat if it is still running. All cells must finish within 300 seconds.
6. Prove VM isolation from the parent: after both children complete, exec must find neither child-only file in the parent's output directory. Do not copy these marker files to the parent. Use the actual returned child totals and IDs in capability-ledger.md, retain the real README excerpts, and finish only when both children are completed. Do not assert API permission checks passed; those are outside this fixture.
